i18n.name: 本地应用安装
i18n.description: 网页端上传 .tpk 安装包的入口：把本地安装包注册进应用中心并自动安装/升级。支持拖拽上传、本地包库管理（重装 / 下载 / 删除）与环境自检。
i18n.author: 西了个瓜
i18n.versionContent:
1. 常驻拉包实例（8799）同样读到正确的图标策略：由面板实例落盘共享，两边同源，用它装出来的应用图标不再退化成内嵌图标（手机上白图）。
2. 图标策略新增两级兜底：策略文件、从库里现有图标地址反推 —— 换机器或误删配置后不会静默退回内嵌。
3. 应用中心安装时可填写本机 HTTPS 前缀，手机端图标一步到位；两处配置互通，填一处即可。

i18n.name: Local App Installer
i18n.description: Upload local .tpk packages, register them into the app center and install/upgrade automatically. Includes drag-and-drop upload, a local package library (reinstall / download / delete) and an environment self-check.
i18n.author: 西了个瓜
i18n.versionContent:
1. The always-on package-source instance (8799) now resolves the same icon policy as the panel instance, so apps installed through it no longer fall back to inline icons (blank on phones).
2. Two extra fallbacks for the icon policy: a shared policy file, and inference from the URLs already stored in the app-center database.
3. The app-center install form now accepts the HTTPS prefix of this machine, so phone icons work right away.

i18ns.name: 本机 HTTPS 前缀（手机端图标需要，留空 = 图标内嵌）
i18ns.description: 填**这台机器自己**的 HTTPS 访问前缀（形如 https://nas.example.com/pc，铁牛 NAS 即中转域名，注意要带 /pc）。手机 App 不渲染内嵌的 data: 图标；填了之后图标改用绝对地址，桌面/局域网/中转/手机四端全通。留空则内嵌进数据库（桌面/局域网/中转正常，手机白图）。

i18ns.name: HTTPS base URL of this machine (for phone icons; empty = inline)
i18ns.description: The HTTPS prefix of THIS machine (e.g. https://nas.example.com/pc - include the /pc part). Phone clients do not render inline data: icons; with this set, icons use absolute URLs and work on desktop, LAN, relay and phone alike. Left empty, icons are embedded into the database (desktop/LAN/relay only).

i18ns.name: 访问口令（留空则首次打开页面时设置）
i18ns.description: 打开安装器页面时需要输入的口令。安装包里的脚本以 root 在 NAS 上执行，所以这个页面不能没有口令。留空则由第一个打开页面的人自行设置（不需要 root 权限）。

i18ns.name: Access password (set on first page open if empty)
i18ns.description: Password required to open the installer page. Scripts inside installed packages run as root on the NAS, so this page must be protected. Left empty, the first visitor sets it on the page (no root needed).
